en.text:
<solar/>Solar Kills extend the duration of <solar/>Restoration and <solar/>Radiant effects up to the maximum of 15 seconds.

Scoring a <solar/>Solar Kill while <solar/>Restoration's or <solar/>Radiant's timer is above 15 seconds will lower it back down to 15 seconds.

Seconds added based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 1.5s
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 2.25s
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites, Enemy Players: 3s
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 6s
